scripts.build: esbuild server/index.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --outfile=play/_service.js --banner:js="// Generated from server/ by npm run build. Edit those files, not this one."
scripts.dev: npm run build && (npm run watch & yard dev)
scripts.check: npm run build && esbuild play/js/main.js --bundle --format=esm --external:three --outfile=/dev/null --log-level=warning && yard service check
